ev.q: Forty-two percent (65 of 155) of ill persons were aged ≤10 years, and 28% (29 of 103) were hospitalized
Eighty-six percent (80 of 93) of ill persons who were interviewed reported live poultry contact
the average time from purchase of poultry to illness onset was 21 days (range = 2–52 days)
